title: A bulk discount and VAT shown line by line
class: Pricing and tax interaction across files
story: A takes 10% off a line of ten or more, in pricing.ts. B shows the VAT on each line, and in tax.ts works it out from the product's price times the quantity, which is what a line cost on B's base. Together, a discounted line is taxed on its price before the discount.

a.why: ten or more of an item take 10% off

fact.sentence: Ten or more of an item take 10% off the line, before VAT is added

b.why: show the VAT on each line of a quote

fact.sentence: A quote shows the VAT on each line

resolution: tax.ts takes the line's price as charged (lineVat(cents)), and pricing.ts passes it the discounted line.
